title: Virtualize a Long List with react-window
prompt:
Render only the visible rows of a 10k-row list using `FixedSizeList` from `react-window`. **Requirements:** 1. Import `FixedSizeList`, `ListChildComponentProps` from `react-window`. 2. Define and export `type Row = { id: number; label: string }`. 3. Export a function component `BigList({ rows }: { rows: Row[] })`. 4. Inside, define a `Item` row component typed `({ index, style }: ListChildComponentProps) => JSX.Element` that returns a `
{rows[index].label}
`. 5. Render `{Item}`.
hints: Virtualization renders only what's visible; a 10k-row plain `<ul>` would freeze the page.
The row component is invoked by `FixedSizeList` with `{ index, style }` -- always spread `style` so absolute positioning works.
`itemSize` is the row height in px; `height` is the viewport. The library mounts ~`Math.ceil(height / itemSize)` rows.
